useCases: Product teams verify materials comply with environmental and safety regulations before production begins.
Compliance officers confirm hazardous substance documentation is complete and accessible.
Supply chain ensures all incoming materials meet corporate hazard thresholds.
Manufacturing confirms all components in the product structure meet material safety and engineering requirements.
Engineering change management ensures BOMs remain compliant when modifications occur.
Quality assurance validates material selections before production execution.
Safety officers ensure all engineering changes trigger integrated compliance assessments across the organization.
Compliance teams automate material and process safety validation to reduce manual review time.
Operations leadership maintains consistent safety standards across all product variants and manufacturing locations.
Procurement teams confirm vendors can supply materials that meet all compliance requirements before issuing purchase orders.
Supply chain partners communicate material specifications and regulatory requirements through standardized purchase order network.
Vendor management validates that suppliers maintain certification and compliance credentials for regulated materials.
